issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Prelint
products.tagline: Prevent product drift in AI-written code
products.summaryZh: 防止AI编写代码中的产品漂移
products.descriptionZh: AI以10倍速度编写代码。Prelint确保代码正确——它根据你的ADR、文档和过往决策审查每个PR，在代码发布前捕获产品偏差。在使用多个AI审查工具的团队中，合并前修复的问题中约40%由Prelint发现。
products.description: AI writes your code at 10× speed. Prelint makes sure it's the right code - it reviews every PR against your ADRs, docs and past decisions, and catches product drift before it ships. On teams using several AI reviewers, ~40% of the issues fixed before merge are caught by Prelint.

products.name: SoundGate Guitar
products.tagline: AI Music Tutor that gives real-time feedback on your playing
products.summaryZh: AI音乐导师，实时反馈你的演奏表现
products.descriptionZh: SoundGate Guitar是一款能真正聆听你演奏的AI练习伴侣。通过零延迟音符检测，在交互式指板上提供即时视觉反馈。内置AI导师会分析你的演奏，提供个性化反馈、定制练习计划，并解答任何吉他相关问题。
products.description: SoundGate Guitar is an AI practice companion that actually listens to you play. Get instant visual feedback on an interactive fretboard with zero-lag note detection. The built-in AI tutor analyzes your playing to provide personalized feedback, custom practice routines, and answers to any guitar question.

products.name: Denovo
products.tagline: Turn your vibe-coded app into paying customers
products.summaryZh: 将你的氛围编码应用转化为付费用户
products.descriptionZh: 你用AI写完了应用，然后呢？🤔 AI让开发变得简单，但获取客户才是难点。Denovo帮你直接从想法走向营收。💸 获得一个预置Stripe、可直接转化的网站，外加自动增长引擎——向1亿潜在客户发送邮件，并为你配置好Meta广告投放。🚀 只需问一句“生意怎么样？”，就能看到营收数据和下一步行动。已有15,000+企业在此建成。你的，只差一行代码。
products.description: You vibe-coded your app. Now what? 🤔 AI makes building easy, but getting customers is the hard part. Denovo takes you straight from idea to revenue. 💸 Get a ready-to-convert website with Stripe pre-wired, plus an automated growth engine sending emails to 100M leads and setting up your Meta ads campaigns. 🚀 Just ask "how's business?" for your revenue and next steps. 15,000+ businesses built here. Yours is one line away.

products.name: /mission for Claude Code
products.tagline: Give Claude Code missions to spawn a team of agents
products.summaryZh: 为Claude Code分配任务，以生成一个代理团队。
products.descriptionZh: Medley 是一款免费 Claude Code 插件，适用于超出单次会话规模的工作。输入 /mission 可将目标转化为实时图表，协调 Claude Code 与 Codex 工作进程，审查结果并持续推进。通过 OpenRouter 自带密钥（BYOK）即可接入 Kimi、GLM 等更多模型。
products.description: Medley is a free Claude Code plugin for work bigger than one session. Type /mission to turn an outcome into a live graph, coordinate Claude Code and Codex workers, review the result, and keep going. BYOK via OpenRouter for Kimi, GLM, and more.

products.name: ClinicFrame
products.tagline: Like Granola, but for healthcare. Fully HIPAA-compliant.
products.summaryZh: 像格兰诺拉麦片一样，但用于医疗保健。完全符合HIPAA标准。
products.descriptionZh: 一款环境式AI记录工具，可实时生成临床笔记，让你专注于患者诊疗。它能无感捕捉每次问诊（无论是线下还是远程），并在诊疗结束瞬间交付完整、结构化的临床记录。符合HIPAA标准，桌面原生运行，数秒内即可对接电子病历系统。今日我们推出Scribe，但背后有更宏大的愿景：构建一个超越文档记录、支撑完整临床工作流的医疗智能平台。
products.description: An ambient AI scribe that writes clinical notes in real time so you can focus on your patient. It passively captures every visit, whether in person or virtual, and delivers a complete, structured clinical note the moment the encounter ends. HIPAA compliant, desktop native, and EHR ready in seconds. We're launching Scribe today, with a much bigger vision ahead: a medical intelligence platform that goes beyond documentation to support the entire clinical workflow.

products.name: MemoryCustodian
products.tagline: Repo-native memory for coding agents
products.summaryZh: 代码代理的原生仓库内存
products.descriptionZh: MemoryCustodian 为 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini 及其他编码代理提供持久的项目记忆——无需托管服务，也无需让每个提示词变得臃肿。决策、约束、被否决的方案以及项目上下文以纯 Markdown 形式保存在你的仓库中，可以像代码一样被审查、版本管理、共享和删除。通过清单文件，仅加载与每个任务相关的记忆。开源、本地优先、跨代理。
products.description: MemoryCustodian gives Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, and other coding agents durable project memory—without a hosted service or bloating every prompt. Decisions, constraints, rejected approaches, and project context live as plain Markdown in your repo, where they can be reviewed, versioned, shared, and deleted like code. A manifest loads only the memory relevant to each task. Open source, local-first, and cross-agent.

products.name: Totem
products.tagline: Your Twitter bookmarks organized to make you read them
products.summaryZh: 你的Twitter书签已整理，方便你阅读。
products.descriptionZh: 你在X上收藏了精彩帖文，却再也没看过。Totem将你的新标签页变成无干扰的阅读环境，就像在Substack上阅读一样。可以全宽打开帖文、高亮重点、搜索全部内容、导出等。
products.description: You bookmark great threads on X and never see them again. Totem turns your new tab into a distraction-free environment for those bookmarks, the way you'd read on Substack. Open a thread full-width, highlight what matters, search everything, export etc.

products.name: Bo AI
products.tagline: An AI personal assistant that lives in your texts 💬
products.summaryZh: 一个住在你短信里的AI个人助理 💬
products.descriptionZh: Bo是首个面向普通用户的消费级AI产品。通过短信，Bo能帮你保持条理、节省时间、活得更健康，并回答你的问题。
products.description: Bo is the first consumer AI product that exists to serve everyday people. Bo helps you stay organized, save time, live healthier, and answer your questions—all via text.

products.name: Task Monki
products.tagline: Run coding agents through the full development process
products.summaryZh: 通过完整的开发流程运行编码代理
products.descriptionZh: Task Monki 是一款开源桌面应用，用于管理从任务到拉取请求的编码代理。可同时运行多个任务，跟踪每个代理的进度，预览所有结果，无需手动设置服务或容器；可将工作发送给其他代理进行审查和修复；还能让多个代理参与同一讨论，在此过程中它们可以相互回应、比较方法并质疑假设。
products.description: Task Monki is an open-source desktop app for managing coding agents from task to pull request. Run several tasks at once, follow each agent’s progress, preview every result without manually setting up services or containers, send work to another agent for review and fixes, and bring multiple agents into the same discussion, where they can respond to each other, compare approaches, and challenge assumptions.

products.name: Vela
products.tagline: The AI Recruiting Coordinator
products.summaryZh: AI招聘协调员
products.descriptionZh: Vela 是一款 AI 招聘协调工具。只需在任意邮件线程中抄送它，它就能接管：候选人筛选、多轮面试流程及完整面试小组。它能提供可选时间、跟进沉默的候选人、处理改期、随邀请函发送简历、安排准备会议并收集反馈。支持邮件、短信、WhatsApp、Slack 和电话，覆盖所有时区，全天候运行。无需链接、无需登录，团队无需学习任何新内容。受到全球顶尖招聘人员的信赖，并获得 YC、CRV 及其他优秀投资机构的支持。
products.description: Vela is an AI recruiting coordinator. Cc it on any email thread and it takes over: candidate screens, multi-round loops, and full panels. It offers times, chases people who go quiet, handles reschedules, sends the resume with the invite, books prep calls, and collects feedback. Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, and phone, every time zone, 24/7. No links, no logins, nothing new for your team to learn. Trusted by The World's Best Recruiters, and backed by YC, CRV, and other incredible investors.

products.name: Epilude
products.tagline: Local voice dictation for Mac for polished text
products.summaryZh: Mac本地语音听写，生成精炼文本
products.descriptionZh: 按住按键，说话，松开：润色后的文字会出现在Mac上的任意应用中。Epilude可在约一秒内完成转录、标点、清理，并匹配你的语气。完全在设备端运行，音频不会离开你的Mac。
products.description: Hold a key, speak, release: polished text lands in any app on your Mac. Epilude transcribes, punctuates, cleans up, and matches your tone in about a second. Runs fully on-device, so audio never leaves your Mac.

products.name: SceneNote
products.tagline: Free video feedback tool for editors & clients
products.summaryZh: 面向编辑和客户的免费视频反馈工具
products.descriptionZh: 其他视频审阅工具都要注册账号、上传文件或订阅付费，而SceneNote一概不需要。粘贴YouTube、Vimeo或Dropbox链接，分享后即可在数秒内收集反馈。支持时间戳评论、在画面上绘制标注、自动转文字的语音笔记、版本管理和任务分配。审阅者无需注册。导出为CSV或EDL格式后，每条批注都会在Premiere、Resolve或Final Cut中自动生成标记。免费使用，因为我们基于链接而非托管视频来构建。
products.description: Every other video review tool wants an account, an upload, or a subscription. SceneNote wants none of them. Paste a YouTube, Vimeo, or Dropbox link, share it, and collect feedback in seconds. Timestamped comments, annotations drawn on the frame, voice notes that transcribe themselves, versions, and tasks. Your reviewers never sign up. Export as CSV or EDL and every note lands as a marker in Premiere, Resolve, or Final Cut. Free because we build on links instead of hosting your video.

products.name: AgentQuartz
products.tagline: Claude & Cursor usage in your macOS menu bar
products.summaryZh: 在 macOS 菜单栏中使用 Claude 和 Cursor
products.descriptionZh: 本地优先的macOS菜单栏伴侣，适用于Claude和Cursor使用。无需打开浏览器标签页即可查看使用限额。无需AgentQuartz云账户——设置保留在你的设备上。基础功能永久免费；Pro版一次性支付3美元解锁托盘自定义。非官方产品。
products.description: Local-first macOS menu-bar companion for Claude and Cursor usage. Glance at limits without a browser tab. No AgentQuartz cloud account — settings stay on your machine. Free forever for essentials; Pro is a one-time $3 unlock for tray customization. Unofficial.

products.name: BlackFlare
products.tagline: Mission control for Claude Code & Codex in your menu bar
products.summaryZh: Claude Code 与 Codex 的任务控制中心，位于菜单栏中。
products.descriptionZh: BlackFlare - 一款适用于 Claude Code 和 Codex 的原生 macOS 菜单栏应用。在长时间运行期间保持 Mac 唤醒，在会话完成或需要你时收到通知，从菜单切换默认设置，并查看计划用量——全部在设备端完成。
products.description: BlackFlare - a native macOS menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex. Keep your Mac awake during long runs, get notified when a session finishes or needs you, switch your defaults from the menu, and watch plan usage — all on-device.

products.name: JusTTY
products.tagline: A simple native macOS terminal built on Swift and libghostty
products.summaryZh: 基于Swift和libghostty构建的简洁原生macOS终端
products.descriptionZh: 一个用Swift和libghostty构建的简洁原生macOS终端。设计极简——适合日常使用，只是没有高级用户期望的那些花哨功能。
products.description: A simple native macOS terminal built with Swift and libghostty. Minimal be design - suited for everyday use, just not packed with the bells and whistles power users expect.

products.name: EQK 3.0
products.tagline: Mac app with dynamic AI Equaliser
products.summaryZh: 动态AI均衡器Mac应用
products.descriptionZh: EQK 是首款搭载动态AI均衡器的Mac应用——能根据每首歌曲实时自动调整均衡参数。可为每个应用单独设置均衡器、耳机校正和输出设备。无需虚拟驱动，直接通过macOS原生音频捕获。配备10段参数化Tone Desk均衡器、3985+款AutoEq耳机配置文件、独立应用限幅器、完整信号链计量功能，以及内置免费FLAC播放器（支持同步歌词播放本地音乐）。完全本地运行，无遥测数据，无需订阅。让Mac上每个应用都获得专属调音。
products.description: EQK is the first Mac app with dynamic AI EQ - an equalizer that re-tunes itself per song in real time. Give every app its own EQ, headphone correction, and output device. No virtual drivers - just native macOS audio capture. 10-band parametric Tone Desk, 3,985+ AutoEq headphone profiles, per-app limiter, full signal-chain metering, and a free built-in FLAC player with synced lyrics for the songs that you own. 100% local, no telemetry, no subscription. Tune every app on your Mac.

products.name: ResumizeAI
products.tagline: Take full control of your job hunt
products.summaryZh: 全面掌控你的求职过程
products.descriptionZh: 在Resumize中粘贴任意职位描述，或直接搜索实时职位，AI会根据你的真实经历，在数秒内为你量身定制简历和求职信。可导出精美的PDF，或在专属链接上发布可分享的个人档案。专为消除求职申请的繁琐工作而设计，逐个攻克职位申请。
products.description: Paste any job posting, or search live openings right inside Resumize, and AI tailors your resume and cover letter to it in seconds by matching your real experience. Export a polished PDF or publish a shareable profile at your own URL. Built to kill the busywork of applying, one job at a time.

products.name: CellCog
products.tagline: Hire AI employees that form teams and manage each other
products.summaryZh: 雇佣AI员工，组建团队并实现相互管理。
products.descriptionZh: 通过提示词，为任何可描述的岗位雇佣AI员工。每位AI员工都配备收件箱、记忆、轮班和任务板——基于2026年7月Deep Research Bench排名第一的超级智能体构建。它们能组建团队、互相引导和管理。仅需数日，通过提示词即可打造一支运作中的劳动力队伍。
products.description: Hire AI employees for any role you can describe in a prompt. Each has an inbox, memory, shifts, and a task board — built on the super-agent that's #1 on Deep Research Bench (July 2026). They form teams, onboard and manage each other. A working workforce in days, all through prompts.

products.name: Resume Support by Blomma
products.tagline: Get past the ATS with practical advice, skills and edits
products.summaryZh: 用实用建议、技能和修改，通过ATS筛选
products.descriptionZh: 投了简历却从未接到过电话？通常，你的简历在被人阅读之前，就会被应聘者追踪系统（ATS）筛掉……而你永远不知道原因。Blomma的新工具能让你看到简历在ATS、招聘人员和招聘经理眼中的呈现方式，然后帮你找出哪些技能应该重点突出、哪些需要提升，并围绕能获得回应的实际成果重写简历。我们无法保证你得到工作——但能帮你让技能被看见。
products.description: Ever applied for a job and never even gotten a call? Often your resume is filtered out by an applicant tracking system (ATS) before a person ever reads it... and you never get to know why. Blomma's new tool shows you how yours reads (to the ATS, the recruiter, and the hiring manager) then helps you spot the skills to put front and center, the ones to build, and rewrites your resume around the real outcomes that get callbacks. We can't promise you the job—but we'll help your skills get seen.

products.name: ClariLayer
products.tagline: AI context layer for analysts
products.summaryZh: 面向分析师的人工智能上下文层
products.descriptionZh: ClariLayer 是一个上下文层，可与您日常使用的任何AI连接，从而为您提供关于数据、指标、分析等的持久上下文。该上下文具有持久性，可跨会话和跨工具使用，因此您无需重复解释您的数据。
products.description: ClariLayer is a context layer that connects with any AI you use day to day, so you have durable context about you data, metrics, analysis, etc. The context is durable, cross-sessions and cross-tools, so you will never need to re-explain your data.
